title: A MAP TAG STEPS ASIDE BEFORE IT STEPS DOWN
why: Seen on the 4K map screenshot of 2026-10-08: when a marker tag on the sector map clashed with another label, the placer (v19.02) tried moving it down before moving it aside, and since a tag sits just above its marker, down put it across its own marker (CACHE printed through its ring). Up and the sides are tried first now, down last.
now: Map tags no longer land on top of their own markers.
